units: <cite ref="Pesachim 27a:8">Pes. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>דהא קא מקבלא ב׳ מקמיה דניתו וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דהא קבלה … דניתן</he>) for it receives the dish (to be prepared), before yet they put the wood &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38a:11">Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>קרובי ב׳ וכ׳</he> to accelerate boiling (make it quicker done) is something essential.
